verdict_by_frozen_key: FAILED. Seven cells miss the magnitude gate. sw28 CLEARS the magnitude gate (+0.00010687 against 0.00008) with an exceptionally stable gain (se 4.6e-06, positive on 96/96 splits) but its ridge weight is negative on 96/96 splits, violating the preregistered maximum_negative_weight_fraction of 0.10. The threshold is NOT relaxed after seeing the result.
channel_restriction_is_closed: Restricting the CHANNEL view (search side, catalog side, no-amount, activity, intent, money-only) produced negative incremental gain in every case. Channel decomposition does not decorrelate a model from the pool.
what_did_work: Restricting the TIME view. Window 28 is the only cell with a real effect, and window 14 is already too short (+6.2e-06). The effect is therefore specific to a short-but-not-tiny recent window.
interpretation_of_the_negative_weight: Adding sw28 with weight -0.05 to a pool that already contains w409c and decay spans the same subspace as adding the contrast 'long history minus recent 28 days' with a POSITIVE weight. The sign is a property of the parameterisation, not evidence that the signal is spurious. The mechanism is mean reversion: for a user on a temporary spike, the last 28 days overstate the long-run rate and the ridge subtracts it.
why_this_is_not_post_hoc_inversion: The STRATEGY rule states that a negative post-hoc weight does not turn a FAILED PROBE into a finding. No probe was submitted here. The sign was measured offline across 96 splits before any public exposure.
follow_up: A separate round with its own frozen key and an explicitly charged adaptive-selection cost, since the hypothesis was formed after seeing this result. See work/146_mean_reversion_preregister.json.
